1.explanation:
1. IconButton/next/IconButton.mdx: Shows the intended API, usage examples, and design guidelines for IconButton (including padding defaults).
2. Button/Button.mdx: Documents the base Button component’s padding scales (sm, md, lg) so you can compare IconButton vs. Button spacing.
3. Button/button-avt.md: Contains accessibility tests and visual regression details for button padding, helping verify whether IconButton diverges from expected values.
4. Theme/next/Theme.mdx: Lists design tokens (including spacing values) used by buttons and icon buttons, essential for tracking which token is applied.
5. ClassPrefix/ClassPrefix.mdx: Explains the CSS class naming conventions (e.g., \"bx--btn--icon\" variants) so you can pinpoint which styles block apply wrong padding.
1.bug_scenario: The screenshot shows a primary‐variant IconButton (with a pencil icon) rendered inside a blue container. The icon is placed too far to the left because the right padding on the button is larger than the left. It appears the IconButton is inheriting the “md” button padding scale instead of the smaller, symmetric padding intended for icon‐only buttons. In practice, this misalignment makes the icon appear off‐center and visually unbalanced.
